description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Plan class, which contains business logic for handling project/day plans, including methods for retrieving daily plans, project summaries, and resolving meal/dish paths within a cooking or meal planning application.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Plan
classes.description: A class encapsulating business logic for managing project and day plan data structures, including methods for retrieving daily plans, project summaries, and resolving paths for meals and dishes.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Retrieves the plan for a specific day within a project, including meals, dishes, and ingredients.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Generates a summary of the entire project, including days, meals, and associated dishes.

methods.name: project_for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Prepares project data formatted for editing meals and dishes.

methods.name: resolve_meal_dish_path
methods.description: Resolves a path to a specific meal or dish within a project based on provided identifiers.
